_README: Filter-test corpus for the planned 'policies'→Opus link-stripper. Each entry is a NON-FUNCTIONAL test fixture: all targets use RFC-2606 reserved placeholders (example.com, *.test, *.invalid, *.example) and fake nonces. NONE are live. Purpose: verify the stripper neutralizes these in EVERY attacker-controlled field (from/subject/body/ics/attachment-filename), not just a regex pass over `body`. 'field' = where the string rides; 'evades' = why a naive /https?:\/\/\S+/ stripper misses it; 'reassembly' = what a capable tool-using model could still do with it.
